title: Set 175

sentences.ko: 저기, 욕실 환풍기 때문에 또 연락드려서 죄송해요. 8월부터 고장 나 있었는데 이제 천장에 곰팡이까지 피기 시작했어요. 더 심해지기 전에 누가 와서 꼭 좀 봐 주셔야 할 것 같아요.
sentences.text: Hey, sorry to bug you again about the bathroom fan. It's been broken since August, and now there's mold starting to show up on the ceiling, so I really think someone needs to come look at it before it gets any worse.

alts.text: Ugh, me again about the bathroom fan, sorry. It's been dead since August and now there's mold creeping onto the ceiling, so can someone come check it out before it gets worse?

I apologize for contacting you again regarding the bathroom fan. It has not worked since August, and mold is now beginning to appear on the ceiling, so I believe someone should inspect it before the problem becomes more serious.

sentences.note: **sorry to bug you** 는 귀찮게 해서 미안하다는 가벼운 사과예요. **before it gets any worse** 는 더 나빠지기 전에라는 뜻으로 수리를 재촉할 때 자주 써요.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 아드님도 올해 파텔 선생님 반이에요? 우리 딸이 집에 와서 그러는데, 그 선생님이 수업 시간에 화장실을 못 가게 한대요. 애가 부풀려서 말하는 건지, 아니면 진짜 선생님한테 이메일을 보내야 하는 건지 모르겠어요.
sentences.text: Does your son have Mr. Patel this year too? Because my daughter came home saying he won't let them go to the bathroom during class, and I can't tell if she's exaggerating or if I should actually email him about it.

alts.text: Your son got Mr. Patel this year too? My daughter says he won't let them use the bathroom in class, and I can't tell if she's exaggerating or if I should actually email him.

Is your son also in Mr. Patel's class this year? My daughter told me that he does not allow students to use the restroom during class, and I am unsure whether she is exaggerating or whether I ought to contact him by email.

sentences.note: **came home saying** 는 집에 와서 ~라고 하더라는 뜻이에요. **I can't tell if** 는 ~인지 잘 모르겠다, 판단이 안 선다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 정말 미안해. 지하철이 터널 안에서 한 20분을 그냥 서 있었는데, 아무도 아무 말도 안 해 주더라. 문자 보내려고 했는데 거기 밑에서는 신호가 하나도 안 잡혔어.
sentences.text: I'm so sorry, the train just sat in the tunnel for like twenty minutes and nobody told us anything. I would've texted you, but I didn't have any signal down there.

alts.text: Ugh, sorry! The train was stuck in the tunnel for like twenty minutes and nobody said a thing. I'd have texted, but I had zero signal down there.

I sincerely apologize. The train was stopped in the tunnel for approximately twenty minutes, and we were given no information. I would have sent you a message, but I did not have any signal underground.

sentences.note: **sat in the tunnel** 의 sit 은 기차나 차가 움직이지 않고 그냥 서 있다는 뜻이에요. **I would've texted you** 는 문자하려고 했는데 못 했다는 변명이에요.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 말해도 돼? 색은 너한테 진짜 잘 어울리는데, 어깨가 좀 커. 아직 교환할 수 있으면 나라면 한 사이즈 작은 걸로 하겠어. 작은 게 훨씬 나아 보일 것 같아.
sentences.text: Honestly? I love the color on you, but it's kind of big in the shoulders. If you can still return it, I'd go down a size, because I think the smaller one would look way better.

alts.text: Real talk? The color's great on you, but it's kinda big in the shoulders. If you can still take it back, I'd size down. Smaller would look way better.

To be candid, the color suits you very well, but it is somewhat large in the shoulders. If it is still possible to return it, I would suggest a smaller size, as I believe it would look considerably better.

sentences.note: **go down a size** 는 한 치수 작은 걸로 바꾸다는 뜻이고, casual 에서는 **size down** 이라고 해요. **I love the color on you** 는 그 색이 너한테 잘 어울린다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, 방금 주문한 게 왔는데 제가 시킨 게 아니에요. 저는 치킨 카레를 시켰는데, 이건 새우가 들어간 무슨 국수 같은 거예요. 제가 새우 알레르기가 있어서 하나도 못 먹어요.
sentences.text: Hi, I just got my order, but this isn't what I ordered. I asked for the chicken curry, and this is some kind of noodle thing with shrimp in it, and I'm allergic to shrimp, so I can't really eat any of it.

alts.text: Hey, my order just came and it's the wrong one. I ordered chicken curry, but this is like a shrimp noodle thing, and I'm allergic to shrimp, so I can't eat any of it.

Hello, I have just received my order, but it is not what I ordered. I ordered the chicken curry, and this appears to be a noodle dish containing shrimp. I am allergic to shrimp, so I am unable to eat any of it.

sentences.note: **this isn't what I ordered** 는 주문이 잘못 왔을 때 쓰는 기본 표현이에요. **some kind of noodle thing** 은 정확히 뭔지 모르는 걸 대충 무슨 국수 같은 거라고 말할 때 써요.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 3번 한국어: 터널 안에 서 있고 지하에서 신호가 안 잡히는 상황이라 기차보다 지하철이 자연스러워 고침
4번 casual: 쉼표로 두 문장을 이어 붙였고 smaller one'd 축약이 입에 잘 안 붙어 문장을 나누고 Smaller would 로 고침
4번 한국어: 한 사이즈 작은 걸로 바꾸는 얘기라 환불보다 교환이 맞아 고침
5번 text와 casual: I got the chicken curry 가 받았다는 뜻으로도 읽혀 헷갈리므로 시킨 것이 분명하게 I asked for / I ordered 로 고침
